description: Ex-Pan Am 707-321B flown by Líneas Aéreas Paraguayas 1978-1994 and later the presidential FAP-01; preserved in LAP colours as the centrepiece of the LAP history museum at the Hotel del Rancho. Photographed in place February 2025.
museum_name: Museo de la Historia de Líneas Aéreas Paraguayas (Hotel del Rancho), Loma Grande
